trans-10,ciss-12 CLA reduced lipogenesis in the adipose tissue of nonlactating Holstein cows.
the direct effect of the biohydrogenation intermediate trans-10,cin-12 CLA on adipose tissue is to reduce lipogenesis, whereas acetate has no effect on adipose tissue.
trans-10,ciss12 CLA and acetatetreatment did not increase lipogenesis in adipose tissue of nonlactating Holstein cows.

the effect of trans-18:2 CLA and its precursor, linoleic acid on the lipid metabolism of adipose tissue in the nonlating cow.
the effect of trans- 10, cis- 12 CLA on lipid metabolism in non-lactating dairy cows.
the direct and indirect effects of trans- 10,cis- 12 CLA and acetates on adipose tissue metabolism.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the direct effect of dietary CLA and the effect of nutrients spared from milk synthesis on adipose tissue metabolism are not additive, and that CLA and nutrients spared from milk have an antagonistic effect on adipose tissue.

trans-10,c is-12 CLA is a potent inhibitor of lipogenic enzymes and transcription factors, and this effect is not modified by acetate.
